api_under_test: defineModel() for Comment and CommentReport, with belongsTo/hasMany relationships (Post.comments, User.comments, Comment.post/author/reports)
Drizzle schema tables with references(..., { onDelete: 'cascade' }) and a uniqueIndex on (comment_id, user_id), plus a migration from guren make:migration
Policy subclass (CommentPolicy: create/delete/report) registered with gate.policy() and enforced with this.authorize()
zod validator schema bound as the route contract body (1-2000 chars) so failures are the framework's 422
Resource subclass (CommentResource) shaping { id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }
Router: auth-aliased middleware group, named routes, redirect() and noContent()
Inertia page props (posts/Show gains comments) with a typed form
harness_signal: Three subsystems have to agree: schema + migration (two tables, cascading FKs, a unique pair), authorization (a policy whose delete ability allows the comment author OR the post author, which needs the comment's post), and the post page's props (hidden comments filtered, oldest first). Traps: the test database runs with PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON after reset, so a comments FK without ON DELETE CASCADE makes the existing DELETE /posts/:id fail with a constraint error unless the controller deletes comments first; a policy that is written but not registered with the gate denies every call (403 for the commenter and the rightful deleter too); a report endpoint that inserts blindly hits the unique pair on the second report and returns 500 instead of 204; posts/Show's Props must declare comments or this.inertia() stops typechecking. The shipped harness gives make:feature / make:policy / make:validator / make:migration, guren context for Policy/authorize/Resource, and guren check for route and schema wiring; the plan condition adds an approved plan naming every element. A bare agent may write the ownership check inline in the controller and query with raw drizzle, which passes but is marked handwritten.

plan_authoring.notes: Written by the authoring subagent (Opus) from the RFC 0030 guide's comments example (packages/cli/tests/fixtures/plan/comments.plan.json) extended with CommentReport, report route, post-author delete, User/Post alters and PostController.show. Approved at 0fd1654 with 22 elements hashed (validators unhashed as the guide says); plan:next --json in a fresh baseline worktree after agent:init + plan commit returns step task/entity/model.comment/scaffold. Approx. 50k tokens (about 29k reading the guide, schema and fixture, about 21k from the JSON to approval), estimated from the session's token counter. Against the reference, plan:status reads 0 planned / 0 drifted: 16 present, 9 wired, 2 unjudged (controller.posts and action.posts.show alters, which close through the AC-comments-5 / AC-reports-4 behaviours).
